screen.nyanlex.help.title: Manual
screen.nyanlex.help.body:
Chat messages and entity name tags are always translated automatically.

Press [G] to open Translation Settings, [P] to translate the whole screen that is open, and [R] to translate the item you point at (or the item in your hand when no screen is open). You can change these keys under Translation Settings > General > Keys.

Online translation is off by default. On first use, go through Quick setup, or turn Online translation on under Translation Settings > General. While it is off, only saved translations are shown and no text is sent; pressing [R] or [P] first asks whether to start online translation.

The translation service can be AI or Machine translation. With AI, item and screen text is translated automatically like chat, and [R] or [P] forces a fresh translation. With machine translation (Google Translate, an unofficial endpoint that may be limited at any time), items and screens are not translated automatically; press [R] or [P] to send them. AI needs your own API key or a ChatGPT login (which uses your account's Codex quota); the API key is stored only on this computer and is never uploaded.

Using machine translation when AI fails only matters while AI is selected.

Do-not-translate terms keep server or brand names in their original form (case-insensitive, whole words).

My translations lets you export or import the saved translations for the current language; Advanced holds the translation cooldown and the chat order. With debug mode on, the translation status is shown in a corner of the screen.

screen.nyanlex.setup.welcome.title: Welcome to NyanLex Translator
screen.nyanlex.setup.welcome.body: The setup helper walks you through a few simple choices so the text in the game turns into a language you can read.
screen.nyanlex.setup.welcome.hint: You can change all of these later in Translation Settings.
screen.nyanlex.setup.method.title: How would you like to translate?
screen.nyanlex.setup.method.machine.desc: Works with no setup. Chat and similar text is translated automatically; items and screens need a key press (R translates an item and P translates the whole screen by default). Text is sent to Google Translate (unofficial endpoint).
screen.nyanlex.setup.method.ai.desc: More natural translations, and items and screens are translated automatically too. You need your own API key, or a ChatGPT login (which uses your account's Codex quota).
screen.nyanlex.setup.method.off.desc: Keep online translation off. Only translations that already exist are shown, and no text is sent anywhere.
screen.nyanlex.setup.method.hint: Only text you chose to translate is sent. You can turn Online translation off in the settings at any time.
screen.nyanlex.setup.method.ai_missing: Add an API key or sign in to ChatGPT first to use AI.
screen.nyanlex.setup.done.title: All set!
screen.nyanlex.setup.done.intro: Remember these three keys and you are ready to go:
screen.nyanlex.setup.done.key.item: [%s] Translate the item under the cursor, or the item in your hand when no screen is open
screen.nyanlex.setup.done.key.screen: [%s] Translate the whole screen that is open
screen.nyanlex.setup.done.keys_hint: Keys not comfortable? Change them under Translation Settings > General > Keys.
screen.nyanlex.setup.done.footer: The rest of the details are in the manual, for the day you cannot sleep.
config.nyanlex.online.desc: What is sent: the chat, item and screen text you ask to translate. Where it goes: %s. To stop: turn this switch off and only saved translations are shown.
config.nyanlex.machine.title: Machine translation: Google Translate (unofficial endpoint)
config.nyanlex.machine.desc: With machine translation, items and screens are not translated automatically; press the keys to translate them. Google's unofficial endpoint may be limited or stop working at any time.
config.nyanlex.about.github.desc: By DragonMeow. Source code, updates and bug reports are all there.
screen.nyanlex.help.quick: Too much text? Let the setup helper do it for you
config.nyanlex.surface.hint: Chat and entity name tags are always translated automatically; items, the scoreboard, screens and other text depend on the translation service.
config.nyanlex.mine.hint: Export or import the saved translations for the current language to share or back them up.
nyanlex.composer.title: Chat input translation
nyanlex.composer.hint: Drag the header to move. Translate, review, then send.
nyanlex.composer.ready: Ready to review. Press Enter in chat to send.
nyanlex.composer.changed: Draft or settings changed. Translate again.
nyanlex.composer.failed: Translation failed. Your draft is kept; try again.
nyanlex.composer.too_long: Translation exceeds the chat limit. Shorten your draft.
nyanlex.composer.invalid: Cannot insert this response. Please try again.
nyanlex.composer.command: Enter commands in the chat bar below.
nyanlex.composer.offline: Turn on online translation in settings first.
nyanlex.composer.busy: A request is still running. Please wait.
nyanlex.composer.paused: Translation is rate limited. Retry after the pause.
